account: Candrea et al. (Communications Medicine, 22 October 2024) report a clinical-trial participant with ALS (NCT03567213) at Johns Hopkins. He had a chronically implanted high-density electrocorticographic BCI over sensorimotor cortex. High-gamma power vectors from 128 channels fed a long short-term memory layer with 25 hidden units and fully connected layers. These classified rest versus grasp every 100 ms. The click detector was trained on almost 44 minutes of data (480 trials) collected up to 21 days before use. It then ran for 90 days without retraining. The participant controlled a switch-scanning speller for a total of 626 minutes with a median spelling rate of 10.2 characters per minute. The paper states all data collection and testing were performed in the laboratory. No home use is reported.

ai_role.statement: The LSTM click detector is the decoding element. Its stability without retraining is the paper's main result. The source is a peer-reviewed report by the developers, with no outside corroboration and no use outside the laboratory.

claim_basis: Sources: the makers' peer-reviewed study and the makers' preprint. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.

fields.account: Candrea et al. (Communications Medicine, 22 October 2024) report a clinical-trial participant with ALS (NCT03567213) at Johns Hopkins. He had a chronically implanted high-density electrocorticographic BCI over sensorimotor cortex. High-gamma power vectors from 128 channels fed a long short-term memory layer with 25 hidden units and fully connected layers. These classified rest versus grasp every 100 ms. The click detector was trained on almost 44 minutes of data (480 trials) collected up to 21 days before use. It then ran for 90 days without retraining. The participant controlled a switch-scanning speller for a total of 626 minutes with a median spelling rate of 10.2 characters per minute. The paper states all data collection and testing were performed in the laboratory. No home use is reported.
